lead: A keyed array's type names the value alone — `array<V>` — and `array<string, string>` does not parse.
body: A map literal `["EUR" => "Euro"]` is an `array<string>`, so writing the key type too stops the parser at the comma and cascades: one such declaration in a two-line example produced 64 diagnostics, almost all of them about later lines. Write `array<int> $prices = ["cup" => 450];` and read only the first diagnostic.
